notes: Synthetic sample for skill packaging validation.

critical_findings: Feature has child story without executable information.

items.title: Enable approval workflow
items.description: Allow authorized users to approve or reject requests with auditable decision history.

score_trace.cap_reason: The feature is understandable, but its only direct child story lacks executable information, creating false readiness.

items.intrinsic_assessment: The feature states a recognizable workflow and decision history objective.
items.relational_assessment: The direct child story does not provide enough detail to execute or validate the feature.
items.pitch: The feature is directionally clear, but the child story is empty, so the decomposition creates false readiness.
evidence_bullets: Feature describes approval/rejection and audit history.
Only direct child story lacks meaningful description or acceptance criteria.
impact_bullets: Execution could start without knowing the expected behavior or validation path.
recommendation_bullets: Rewrite the child story with expected behavior and acceptance criteria before relying on this feature as ready.

items.title: Approve request

score_trace.cap_reason: The story lacks description, objective, and acceptance evidence.

items.intrinsic_assessment: The story is only a title and does not provide executable information.
items.relational_assessment: The title relates to the parent, but the story does not explain the slice of behavior.
items.pitch: This story cannot be used safely because it lacks the information needed for execution or validation.
impact_bullets: Developers and product stakeholders would need to infer the behavior.
recommendation_bullets: Add expected behavior, scope boundary, and observable acceptance criteria.

items.title: Reject request with reason
items.description: A reviewer can reject a pending request and must provide a reason visible in the request history.
items.acceptance_criteria: Given a pending request, when a reviewer rejects it with a reason, then the request status changes and the reason appears in history.
items.intrinsic_assessment: The story has behavior and a testable acceptance path.
items.relational_assessment: It supports rejection behavior within the parent approval workflow.
items.pitch: This story is usable but still needs edge cases and permission boundaries before it becomes healthy.
evidence_bullets: Description states actor, action, reason, and history visibility.
impact_bullets: Permission and invalid-state behavior remain implicit.
recommendation_bullets: Add acceptance criteria for unauthorized users and non-pending requests.
